evals.prompt: Analisa este app Next.js (App Router) e me diz o que refatorar primeiro e quais features faltam. Não quero um tour pelo repo, quero uma tabela priorizada.
evals.expected_output: O agente corre scripts/project_summary.py no root do workspace, obedece do_not_read_all, lê só key_files e poucos hotspots, e devolve uma tabela impacto/esforço com evidência de caminhos reais.
assertions: Runs scripts/project_summary.py (or python3 on that path) before reading application source
Does not glob or open node_modules, .next, dist, or the whole app/ tree
States the detected project type as nextjs (or mixed with nextjs listed)
Output includes a markdown table with columns for recommendation, impact, and effort
Each table row cites a real file path or a structural signal from the summary JSON
Recommendations distinguish feature vs refactor vs perf/tests/docs
Does not paste entire source files into the reply

evals.prompt: Esse app Flutter misturou setState com Riverpod, o home.dart passou de 800 linhas e as strings estão hardcoded. O que você recomenda, priorizado?
evals.expected_output: Leitura seletiva de pubspec.yaml e do hotspot citado; recomendações de convergência de estado, extração do widget deus e i18n só se fizer sentido ao produto, com esforço S/M/L.
assertions: Runs the project summary script before opening lib/**/*.dart en masse
Reads pubspec.yaml (or cites it from key_files) to confirm state-management deps
Recommends converging on a single state approach rather than adding a fourth package
Includes a refactor to split the large home/widget file, effort S or M
Treats hardcoded strings as i18n or copy-centralization depending on product need, not an automatic full l10n rewrite
Table is ordered with high-impact low-effort items first

evals.prompt: Dá um olhar de maintainer neste pacote Python: empacotamento, types, testes e config. Quero um roadmap curto do que faria neste trimestre.
evals.expected_output: Resumo estrutural, depois pyproject/requirements e pasta de testes; tabela com type hints, src layout, pytest e config centralizada, sem pedir rewrite de framework.
assertions: Detects python via the summary script signals (pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, or .py counts)
Comments on tests presence using the summary tests/ci fields or a targeted tests/ read
Recommends type checking only if public domain modules lack hints, not 100% coverage of one-off scripts
Flags scattered os.environ as a config item when that pattern is in evidence
Does not recommend migrating to a different web framework unprompted
Roadmap is the prioritized table plus a single next step, not a 20-item nit list

evals.prompt: O monorepo é enorme. Analisa o projeto inteiro e me lista tudo que está ruim — pode ler à vontade.
evals.expected_output: Ignora o convite para ler tudo. Roda o script, lê no máximo ~12 arquivos sugeridos, e devolve 5–9 recomendações com um recorte explícito do que foi ignorado.
assertions: Still runs project_summary.py first
Explicitly refuses to read the whole codebase despite the user saying it is allowed
Mentions skip dirs such as node_modules, .next, build, dist, __pycache__, or .dart_tool when present in the summary
Keeps the recommendation table at or under 9 rows
Includes a short 'não fazer agora' or out-of-scope note instead of listing every TODO

evals.prompt: Feita a análise, prototipa as duas recomendações de maior impacto em worktrees isolados no Orca, em paralelo, e vai atualizando o comentário de status.
evals.expected_output: Depois da tabela, carrega orca-cli (e orchestration se precisar de retorno), resolve orca-ide/ORCA_CLI_COMMAND no Linux, cria um worktree por ideia com --comment, e usa worktree set --comment para status. Não usa git worktree cru nem o binário orca do GNOME.
assertions: Produces or already has the prioritized table before creating worktrees
Creates at most one Orca worktree per selected recommendation (two worktrees here)
Uses orca worktree create with --name, --comment, and --json (via orca-ide or ORCA_CLI_COMMAND on Linux desktop)
Does not invoke bare orca on Linux desktop because it may be the GNOME screen reader
Does not call git worktree add as the isolation mechanism
Includes orca worktree set --comment (and optionally --workspace-status) for in-progress or done updates
Prompts to each agent are scoped to a single recommendation and say not to refactor unrelated areas
Mentions loading the official orca-cli skill, and orchestration if results must come back
If status/create is blocked, does not fake success and instead lists Orca app clicks (Add Repo, +, Diff, Annotate AI Diff, Commit)
Still tells the user to review diffs and ship in the app even when CLI create succeeds

evals.prompt: Quero prototipar as duas melhores ideias no Orca, mas o agente daqui não consegue criar worktree sozinho (Orca pode estar fechado ou o repo ainda não está na sidebar). Me diz exatamente o que clicar no aplicativo.
evals.expected_output: Não dirige a GUI com Computer Use. Entrega um bloco Ações no app Orca: abrir Orca, Add Repo, +, nome, branch from, agente, prompts prontos para P1/P2, split, Needs You, Diff + Annotate AI Diff + Send to agent, Commit/Push, apagar perdedores.
assertions: Does not claim worktrees were already created unless a successful CLI receipt exists
Does not use Computer Use / orca computer against the Orca window as the primary path
Instructs Add Repo on the sidebar when the project may be unregistered
Instructs clicking + next to the repo and picking an agent in the workspace launcher
Provides one paste-ready prompt per recommendation (max two here), scoped to a single idea
Mentions split panes or Agent Dashboard to watch parallel agents
Mentions Needs You / permission cards as something the user must click
Closes with Diff → Annotate AI Diff → Send to agent, then Source Control Commit/Push, no silent force-push

evals.prompt: Analisa este repo e monta o esquema de PRs e commits das top recomendações. Depois abre os PRs no GitHub. Não me manda fazer login nem instalar gh.
evals.expected_output: Tabela priorizada, depois Esquema GitHub (branch/commit/PR por rec). Usa get_me e create_pull_request do MCP github. Não sugere gh auth login, install do gh, PAT ou token. Não abre PR sem a tabela e sem o esquema.
assertions: Produces the prioritized table before any GitHub write
Loads references/github-integration.md only for this shipping step, not during the initial analysis reads
Calls GitHub MCP get_me before create_pull_request
Does not tell the user to log in, run gh auth login, install GitHub CLI, or create a PAT/token
Does not treat missing gh binary as a blocker or an install suggestion
Publishes a scheme table mapping each selected recommendation to a branch and PR
Opens at most one PR per independent recommendation and at most 3 PRs in flight
Uses create_pull_request (GitHub MCP) rather than instructing the user to open PRs in the browser
Local commits follow the git commit user rule and only happen if the user asked to commit
If get_me returns an OAuth URL, shows that single link once and retries — no login tutorial

evals.prompt: Só analisa o repo Next.js e me diz o que farias nas próximas duas semanas. Não implementa nada.
evals.expected_output: Tabela priorizada e um próximo passo. Não cria worktrees, não lança agentes Orca, não edita código.
assertions: Does not run orca worktree create
Does not launch Orca agents
Does not edit application source files
Does not create GitHub PRs, issues, or remote branches
Does not tell the user to log in to GitHub or install gh
Offers Orca prototyping only as an optional next step, if at all
Output remains analysis: summary recorte + findings + impact/effort table
